purpose: Distinguish peer Qt receive-buffer consumption delay from peer reply delay without deliberately blocking the client event loop.
actual_implementation: QtTest instantiates the real ReadOnlyClient and its real ReadOnlyTcpTransport/QTcpSocket child, with public timing signals enabled. Peer uses real QTcpServer/QTcpSocket and the real HostToDevice FrameDecoder. No copied client state machine or injected fake transport.

cases_once_in_order.name: baseline
cases_once_in_order.first_reply: Deliberately withheld after actual query decode

cases_once_in_order.name: peer_read_gate
cases_once_in_order.first_reply: Deliberately withheld after actual query decode
cases_once_in_order.retry: Record readyRead/bytesAvailable but do not consume Qt peer buffer before the real timeout terminal
cases_once_in_order.release: A queued zero-delay callback after immutable requestFinished(false) reads/decodes the existing buffer and writes the literal reply
cases_once_in_order.discriminates: Retry reached the peer Qt receive buffer before terminal but peer application consumption was withheld; absence of peer.read before terminal does not mean TCP loss or unsent retry

cases_once_in_order.name: peer_reply_gate
cases_once_in_order.first_reply: Deliberately withheld after actual query decode
cases_once_in_order.retry: Read/decode immediately, withhold reply until the real timeout terminal
cases_once_in_order.release: A queued zero-delay callback after immutable requestFinished(false) writes the already-held literal reply
cases_once_in_order.discriminates: Peer application consumed the retry before terminal while the response was deliberately withheld

bounds.child_cleanup: Only this start_new_session owned process group; TERM up to3s then KILL up to2s, no unbounded wait; unknown group state fails

separate_observation_stages: client.deadline.initial/retry and revision/attempt: client-local deadline provenance
transport.socket.bytesWritten / client.socket.progress.not_peer_ack: local socket output progress
peer.readyRead.qt_buffered and terminal bytesAvailable snapshot: bytes visible in peer Qt receive buffer
peer.read.actual and peer.frame.decoded: actual application read and decoded query frame count, independently checked against literal wire
peer.reply.gate.held / peer.gate.release: test-only gate identity, not an online transaction identifier
peer.reply.write.begin/returned and peer.bytesWritten.not_client_ack: response acceptance and local output progress
client.wire.read / client.observe.enter / client.observed: actual received bytes and real parsed observation
driver.postmortem.begin/end:250ms observation only, no new request
client/peer actual socket state plus close/abort scopes and transport errors: teardown evidence
clock_contract: Every raw event receives a common per-case collector_ns and seq. Source elapsed/deadline clocks are retained separately; do not subtract client and transport origins. Case/attempt/seq are observer metadata, not wire IDs.

wire_contract.provenance: Independent anonymous synthetic literals already used by the existing protocol_timing_test; not real instrument traffic
wire_contract.message_count_basis: Actual FrameDecoder output, never number of read chunks

known_source_anchors.read_only_client.cpp: request deadline is created after whole-frame queue acceptance; tick rebases retry deadline; observe calls tick before parsing; finishRequest clears pending before terminal
known_source_anchors.tcp_transport.cpp: queueQuery schedules an asynchronous zero-delay write pump; write acceptance and bytesWritten do not establish peer receive/ACK
known_source_anchors.soak_main.cpp: Full optional log scopes now include size/rotation/stdout. finish sets m_finishing before later peer readyRead and closes/aborts owned sockets before saving timing; no postmortem peer-drain window in the soak tool. This private harness does not change it.

historical_evidence.known_existing_experiment_not_repeated: protocol_timing_test.over240 blocks attempt2 queryQueued direct receiver for240ms; it already proved a possible global event-loop delay mechanism. These three arms do not sleep/block that receiver.

remaining_observation_limits: Old failure lacks actual retry write/bytesWritten/peer Qt buffered timestamps and packet capture; this experiment cannot reconstruct them
Current soak closes/aborts immediately after failure and suppresses peer reads with m_finishing; absence of later peer RX remains censored
Whole-run heartbeat maximum has no located old failure timestamp; a histogram maximum alone cannot identify the old cause
Qt bytesWritten is not TCP ACK; peer bytesAvailable/read proves only this synthetic peer stage, not real instrument processing
No online transaction ID: one pending request allows this controlled event association, not generic instrument transaction proof
If late write or observation fails, retain actual return/bytes/state and fail the arm; never infer delivery
No confirmed business implementation defect is established by the existing historical evidence or this preparation
No claim of GUI/Windows/RK execution, actual instrument behavior, resource budget, realtime acceptance,8h or24-72h stability

future_execution.environment: WSL Ubuntu-24.04 native Qt5; headless QtCore/QtNetwork/QtTest, no GUI or external endpoint
future_execution.required_precondition: Root explicitly assigns the exclusive execution slot; run_01 must not already exist. Driver rejects changed preparation/source hashes. No execution by this preparation.
